target: remove variable-disjointness while preserving an exact polynomial composition law

family.construction: For i=1..t place one 3-clause gadget on variables (s_i, a_i, s_{i+1}); consecutive gadgets share exactly the interface variable s_{i+1}. The primal graph is connected for every t>=1.
base_relation: x OR y OR NOT z
NOT x OR NOT y OR z

machine.state: the truth value of the one-variable frontier s_i
machine.transition: for each incoming frontier value, enumerate only the constant local choices for a_i and s_{i+1}, retain exactly those satisfying gadget i
machine.work: O(t) with a fixed constant transition table; no 2^t global assignment product
machine.exactness: DP stores exactly the extendible assignments on the current separator. Induction on the prefix gives equivalence with satisfiability of the processed prefix.
